title: Error
description: Body of every Hub error response. Clients ignore members they do not know.

code.description: Error code. Open (x-open): the Hub may add codes, and a client treats a code it does not know as a plain failure (E21). The known codes are the examples. Mutation outcomes such as id_reuse or not_canonical also appear as a rejected result's reason (E12).

details.description: Code-specific data, such as missing_chunks for incomplete and epoch for epoch_changed.

incomplete_details.description: 409 incomplete from finalize (E19): the chunk indexes still missing.

epoch_changed_details.description: 409 epoch_changed from GET /v1/changes or POST /v1/mutations (D24): the request's CampusLife-Epoch is not the Hub's. epoch is the Hub's, the one the client takes as its own once it has emptied its cache.
